message:
Implemented Fieldnotes with the complete Vanilla Paper 0.10.0 theme, compared against Notebook. Native navigation, editing and filesystem persistence remain intact. Narrow tables reuse Paper’s scrollable wrapper; three source repairs improve controls and reduced motion.

Run from `app/` with `PORT=55111 ./start.sh`. The inspected offline export is `app/wiki/output/index.html`.

Verified on identified owned servers: English/Chinese save→filesystem→reload, cancel, keyboard search/editor, palette switching, three viewport sizes, both themes, Chinese UI and keyboard table scrolling. All 12 final reading/editor captures were personally opened. Final audit confirms eight notes, zero drafts, no duplicate titles and all 8,823 vendored upstream files unchanged.

Delivery and preservation records:

- [FINAL.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/dc68edd00fe1/ui-study/w11/FINAL.md)
- [PRESERVATION.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/dc68edd00fe1/ui-study/w11/PRESERVATION.json)
- [VISUAL-REVIEW.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/dc68edd00fe1/ui-study/w11/VISUAL-REVIEW.md)

Primary captures: `evidence/verified-final/{day,night}-{reading,editing}-{1440,1280,390}.png`. Supplemental captures: `evidence/verified-extra/*.png`. Behavior evidence: `verified-final/behavior.json` and commands `017`, `020`–`023`. Child records: `DELEGATION.json` and `evidence/research/REPORT.md`.

Limits remain: natural-speed playback and full accessibility acceptance were not established. Cross-call deletion anomalies were archived and neutralized, but their cause remains unresolved. Some interim child notifications lack verbatim call-time exports. Timing provenance is recorded without inferring an exact first-action timestamp. All owned test servers have stopped; writes are finished.
scope: Actual primary terminal notification, faithfully exported; export time is not execution timing.
